## Learning goal

Treat a computer as a powered circuit and as an information-processing system.

![Power flows through a sealed PSU to parallel computer loads.](/assets/tej/Computer_Power_Connections.svg){width=94%}

Identify source, conductors, protection, controls, and loads. Then identify input, processing, memory, storage, and output. The PSU is a sealed conversion and protection unit. Read its external label only.

## Activity and evidence

Annotate one real computer photograph and one functional block diagram. Explain why internal loads connect to regulated rails in parallel and why the front-panel power button usually signals control logic instead of directly carrying total load current.
